6.243 rsInvalidFixedDataNotContiguous
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidFixedDataNotContiguous is a critical error that will occur when peer TablixMember elements
with TablixMember.FixedData set to true are not contiguous.
